claims.assertion: Dhor says Rag disabled the Scimitar’s shields during an electric snowstorm to avoid glowing near military sensors; lightning struck the craft.
claims.speaker: Dhor Káal’el
claims.qualifiers: Yazhi later confirms shields were off to avoid detection.

claims.assertion: Dhor says lightning entered through a non-polymorphic antenna, damaged communications and cut muon contact; superconducting cables carried excess charge to engine plasma, but damaged circuits needed replacement.
claims.speaker: Dhor Káal’el
claims.qualifiers: The hull self-repaired, but antenna and electronics did not.

review_flags: The incident and spacecraft systems are presented as unverified first-person testimony.
coverage_gaps: The interview also describes the Scimitar's preparation, flight suits, storm navigation, and a later communications explanation from Yazhi.
